stem:
Tia's classmate has influenza. The school nurse says it is caused by a virus and spreads from person to person through coughs and close contact. The class sorts diseases as communicable, non-communicable, or chronic.

Which label fits influenza best?

options.text: Non-communicable disease, because a virus is involved.
Chronic disease only, because it can last a few days.

teacher.key_rationale: Influenza is caused by a pathogen and spreads person to person, so it is communicable. Calling it non-communicable reverses that mapping. Pathogen cause alone without spread does not define communicable here, and a few days does not make it chronic.
